---
name: design-tokens-and-mockups
description: "Use when creating Gate-OS design tokens, concept mockups, icon choices, theme variants, or rendered design documentation."
---

## Procedure
Define source tokens in JSON; generate CSS/GTK/QSS outputs; use open fonts/assets; create light/dark/high-contrast and LTR/RTL mockups; render at desktop/mobile sizes; label concepts until implemented.

## Verification
No clipped text or overlap, contrast and focus review, token generation is repeatable, and screenshots are stored with provenance.
